# OSGi AsciiDoc Converter

> Wraps AsciidoctorJ as an OSGi service for AsciiDoc document conversion (PDF, EPUB3, HTML, diagrams) within Apache Karaf containers.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ multi-module project (4 modules)
- AsciidoctorJ 2.5.2 with JRuby 9.2.19.0 for Ruby runtime in OSGi
- Deploys as a Karaf 4.4.7 feature with Declarative Services
- Uses OSGi R6 component model with Apache Felix maven-bundle-plugin
- Integration tests via PAX Exam spinning up real Karaf containers
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Comprehensive project documentation — architecture, build commands, technology stack, and development guide
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branching strategy, version numbering, and CI/CD workflow details

## Modules — Service Layer

- [osgi-asciidoc-converter-api/pom.xml](osgi-asciidoc-converter-api/pom.xml): OSGi bundle defining the `AsciidocConverterService` marker interface — the service contract for consumers
- [osgi-asciidoc-converter-impl/pom.xml](osgi-asciidoc-converter-impl/pom.xml): OSGi bundle that creates an Asciidoctor instance via JRuby and registers it in the OSGi service registry, embedding all AsciidoctorJ dependencies (PDF, diagrams, EPUB3)

## Modules — Packaging & Testing

- [osgi-asciidoc-converter-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](osgi-asciidoc-converter-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor bundling SCR, JRuby, API, and impl for one-command deployment
- [osgi-asciidoc-converter-itest/pom.xml](osgi-asciidoc-converter-itest/pom.xml): PAX Exam integration tests — spins up a Karaf container, deploys the feature, and verifies PDF generation with custom themes

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI/CD pipeline (build, deploy, tag, release)
